title: couple months of evenings, claude + codex + elevenlabs - my first game made with ai is now a full game
author: Makari-gamer
selftext:
hey, wanted to share my experience  
made a game with ai - claude and codex helped me with basically everything, sounds are from elevenlabs and suno

did it in a couple months, evenings only. i love games, got inspired by harry potter and sorting games, wanted to make a game and also test what’s actually possible  
it went so well that now it’s a whole game)

don’t want to drag it out and turn it into a big commercial product, so i’m collecting feedback on the demo and releasing at the end of november

main thing i learned - ai can’t come up with ideas. everything like “design this for me” just didn’t work, had to think through all of it myself, all the interesting decisions are mine

really happy with the vfx pipeline. if people like the game and there’s interest, i can do a series of breakdowns on how i made stuff, like the effects  
hands were the biggest pain btw

if you have any questions about pipelines or tools - ask away, happy to tell everything

demo: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5502410/Wave\_Sort\_The\_Magic\_Wand\_Shop\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5502410/Wave_Sort_The_Magic_Wand_Shop_Demo/)

comments.author: boredumo
comments.body:
Nice, I wishlisted it.

The thing that weirds me out the most is that objects don't have shadows seemingly.

There's not enough magical stuff happening yet I think.

Some ideas:

* Moonlight coming through stained-glass windows or a glass dome above the main area
* Dust particles catching the light, with some subtle haze in the air.
* Paintings with living, moving scenes inside them. Their eyes following you
* You could have a pet black cat who is only making things worse by knocking things over or spreading the junk on the floor even more.

Also, a lot of the interior feels too aligned.

EDIT  
And you need animations for things you are cleaning up.  
The candles or torches need to flicker

replies.author: Makari-gamer
replies.body:
thanks a lot!  
moonlight and dust - great idea, was thinking about it, even made a prototype, but didn’t like the visuals and turned it off for now. will try to tweak it again  
pet cat - cool feature, love it, thanks) not sure it’ll work out, but i’ll try  
living paintings - didn’t even think in that direction, interesting idea

thanks so much, really valuable!
